Check the input files before running the 3DCMCCFEM model

Source: R/make_inputs.R
check_inputs.Rd

check_inputs performs the same consistency checks of run_3DCMCCFEM (presence of the input files, parameters of the version 5.7 in the species files, years in stand, meteo and co2 files, management and replanting options) without running the model.

Usage

check_inputs(
  site,
  species,
  year_start,
  year_end,
  man,
  co2 = "on",
  pres_dens = NULL,
  after_pres = NULL,
  reg = "off",
  year_start_man = -9999,
  rep_trees = -9999,
  rep_age = -9999,
  rep_dbh = -9999,
  rep_lai = -9999,
  rep_height = -9999,
  rep_species = -9999,
  reg_species = -9999,
  reg_trees = -9999,
  reg_age = -9999,
  reg_dbh = -9999,
  reg_lai = -9999,
  reg_height = -9999,
  inputdir,
  check_meteo = FALSE
)

Arguments

site

Character: Site name. Used to construct output name

species

Character: Species names (same as parameterization files)

year_start

Integer: Starting year of simulation

year_end

Integer: Ending year of simulation

man

Character: Management options; options: c("on","off","var")

co2

Character: CO2 concentration changes according to scenario; options: c("on","off","var")

pres_dens

Character: Prescribed densities in stand file if man = "var"; options: c("on","off")

after_pres

Character: Management after last year of prescribed density if man = "var"; options: c("on","off")

reg

Character: Regeneration; options: c("on","off")

year_start_man

Integer: If man = "on"; Starting year of management; Default to -9999.

rep_trees, rep_age, rep_dbh, rep_lai, rep_height, rep_species

Replanting parameters (number of trees, age, average DBH, LAI, height and species). Default to -9999.

reg_species

Character: species of saplings. Default to -9999, i.e. the first element of species.

reg_trees

Integer: Number of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_age

Integer: Age of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_dbh

Integer: Average DBH of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_lai

Integer: Average LAI of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_height

Integer: Average height of saplings; Default to -9999.

inputdir

Character: Path to input files directory

check_meteo

Logical: Should the validity of the meteo file be checked with the function check_meteo_3DFEM? Default to FALSE

Value

Invisibly TRUE if all checks are passed, otherwise an error is thrown. Warnings are issued for possible inconsistencies.

See also

run_3DCMCCFEM, setup_inputs

Examples

inp <- system.file("extdata", "bilykriz", "rcp0p0", package = "R3DFEM")
check_inputs("BilyKriz", "Piceaabies", 1997, 2010, man = "off", inputdir = inp)
#> All checks passed
